simple.meaning: פַּתְרֻסִי (Pathruçîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Pathrusite , or inhabitant of Pathros.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: פַּתְרֻסִי (H6625) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 10:14, with occurrences in Genesis, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פַּתְרֻסִי (H6625) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in פַּתְרֻסִי (H6625) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: פַּתְרֻסִי (Pathruçîy) / H6625 is traced through Genesis 10:14, 1 Chronicles 1:12 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
